basis: Updated from R17: HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE and HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE added; OTP concurrency semantics clarified
defect_16_classification: IMPL-MD — alias_intercept interceptor baseline is NEEDS-EXTERNAL

defect_23_r18_classification.T-CONCURRENCY-AUTH: IMPL — implemented with per-worker dirs and pre-worker exit-status classification
defect_23_r18_classification.T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND: IMPL-MD — MANDATORY-DEFERRED; targets phone/WhatsApp OTP hook (not email OTP); HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE and HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE must be supplied before execution
defect_23_r18_classification.T-CONCURRENCY-IDEMPOTENCY-POST: IMPL-MD — MANDATORY-DEFERRED and implementation incomplete; endpoint contract NEEDS-EXTERNAL

alias_intercept.description: Alias account intercept hook. Intercepts auth-with-password for alias accounts.

phone_otp_hook.description: Release 1B phone/WhatsApp OTP endpoint. Required by T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND.

HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE.note: Route registered by the hook package for phone/WhatsApp OTP requests. Must NOT be /api/collections/users/request-otp (that is PocketBase email OTP and is not a substitute).

HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE.note: Local-only route provided by the hook for resetting and inspecting mock-provider state without sending a real delivery. Used as the non-mutating availability probe for T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND.

options: authenticated legacy phone-linking endpoint: each worker needs a unique single-use auth configuration
separately versioned anonymous phone-first endpoint: anonymous workers only; endpoint must be locally enabled and explicitly not production
endpoint_auth_policy.note: Must be specified by the hook manifest before T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND can determine per-worker auth configuration.

required_before_test: initial database and rate-limit state (from mock-provider reset)
whether probe is read-only (must be; real send probe is prohibited)
database request-record count after concurrent run
whether failed provider attempts consume quota

otp_lifecycle_states.note: Exact semantics and allowed final states must be defined by the hook schema before test assertions can be written.

idempotency_hook_note.description: T-CONCURRENCY-IDEMPOTENCY-POST is MANDATORY-DEFERRED and IMPLEMENTATION INCOMPLETE. The endpoint route, idempotency key header name, expected HTTP status for duplicate requests, and duplicate-record prevention behavior are all NEEDS-EXTERNAL. Per-worker isolation will be designed only after the endpoint contract is available.

global_constants.HOOK_SRC_PATHS: All four keys must be configured before --run
global_constants.HOOK_EXPECTED_SHA256: All four keys must be configured before --run
global_constants.HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES: All four keys must match HOOK_SRC_PATHS keys exactly (defect-28 enforces this)
global_constants.HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE: Must be set to the hook-registered phone/WhatsApp OTP route before T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND can run
global_constants.HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE: Must be set to the non-mutating mock-provider control route before T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND can run

nsu_hook_behavior_note: T-NSU-HOOK-BEHAVIOR is DEFERRED-MANDATORY. Hook source must define NSU intercept semantics.
